description: Add text. Point text grows with its content from x, y (the left end of the first baseline); area text flows inside a box of width and height whose top-left is x, y

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

contents.description: The text. Use \r for new paragraphs

layer.description: Layer to draw on. Default: the active layer

leading.description: Leading in points (turns off auto leading)

name.description: Name for the new item (shown in the Layers panel)

tracking.description: Tracking in thousandths of an em

name: create_text
title: Create Text
